name: Cadillac Mines Corporation
summary: Cadillac Mines Corporation engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Canada. It primarily explores gold, sulfide, copper, nickel, and cobalt. The company's flagship project is the Kerr-Addison Project located in McGarry Township, Ontario. The company was formerly known as Gold Candle Ltd. and changed its name to Cadillac Mines Corporation in May 2026. Cadillac Mines Corporation was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
